name: performance

findings.message: The `iter > 0` guard is always true (the loop starts at `_start_iter` ≥ 1), so `eb_emit_event "stage.start"` fires for every cycle member in every iteration on every run—fresh runs included—adding an unconditional I/O call to the innermost dispatch hot path where none existed before.

On the first resumed iteration the CMBR-1 guard forks a `jq` subprocess for each cycle member to read its status from the state file, rather than reading and caching the relevant section once before the member loop.

reason: the performance lens found a medium or high or critical problem the change introduced
